mapper.sql: SELECT m.*, COALESCE(sup.name, su.name, m.sender_id) AS sender_name, COALESCE(rup.name, ru.name, m.receiver_id) AS receiver_name FROM crm_messages m LEFT JOIN crm_users su ON m.sender_type IN ('admin','trainer') AND su.id = m.sender_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles sup ON m.sender_type = 'member' AND sup.user_id = m.sender_id LEFT JOIN crm_users ru ON m.receiver_type IN ('admin','trainer') AND ru.id = m.receiver_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles rup ON m.receiver_type = 'member' AND rup.user_id = m.receiver_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_messages WHERE gym_id = #{gymId} AND sender_id = #{senderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_messages WHERE gym_id = #{gymId} AND is_notice = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_messages (id, gym_id, sender_type, sender_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, content, is_read, is_notice, parent_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{gymId}, #{senderType}, #{senderId}, #{receiverType}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, 0, #{isNotice}, #{parentId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_messages SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND gym_id = #{gymId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM crm_messages WHERE id = #{id} AND gym_id = #{gymId}
mapper.select: SELECT cm.sender_id AS memberId, up.name AS memberName, up.contact AS memberPhone, (SELECT c2.content FROM crm_messages c2 WHERE c2.gym_id = #{gymId} AND c2.sender_type = 'member' AND c2.sender_id = cm.sender_id AND c2.receiver_type = 'admin' ORDER BY c2.created_at DESC, c2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastContent, (SELECT c2.created_at FROM crm_messages c2 WHERE c2.gym_id = #{gymId} AND c2.sender_type = 'member' AND c2.sender_id = cm.sender_id AND c2.receiver_type = 'admin' ORDER BY c2.created_at DESC, c2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_messages c3 WHERE c3.gym_id = #{gymId} AND c3.sender_type = 'member' AND c3.sender_id = cm.sender_id AND c3.receiver_type = 'admin' AND c3.is_read = 0) AS unreadCount FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sender_id FROM crm_messages WHERE gym_id = #{gymId} AND sender_type = 'member' AND receiver_type = 'admin' AND is_read = 0) cm LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = cm.sender_id ORDER BY lastAt DESC
